title: TypeScript Basics
description: Learn TypeScript fundamentals including types, interfaces, and type inference.
longDescription: TypeScript Basics introduces the core language features every TypeScript developer needs. You will start by understanding what TypeScript is and why it catches errors at compile time instead of runtime. Then you will work through primitive types, arrays, and tuples before moving on to interfaces and type aliases for describing object shapes. Functions get full coverage including parameter typing, rest parameters, and function type expressions. The module wraps up with enums and literal types for modeling fixed value sets, and type assertions for bridging between what TypeScript knows and what you know. By the end you will be comfortable reading and writing typed TypeScript code.
whatYouLearn: Work with basic and custom types
